what: A predicate vocabulary mined from Pass A and cut on whether it joins films the current atlas cannot join at all. Nothing here is merged into corpus.json and nothing here is an edge.
boundaries: corpus.json untouched — the proposal says merge only after full-corpus tagging
predicate-tags.seed.json never read, never used as an exemplar, never scored against
estPrevalence and --prior never used; every prevalence here is a count over the 300-film cohort
tonal distance is a diagnostic and a tiebreak, never a strength term
relatives were not read and no edge is proposed from them

baselines.note: measured today over the 44,850 pairs the 300-film cohort makes, from static/corpus.json, pipeline/out/harvest.json, pipeline/out/enrich.json and static/fingerprints.json

generalisationControl.note: films in held-out groups were never shown to the induction stage. If the vocabulary only fits what it was mined from, the held-out "none of these" rate is the tell.

headline.caution: 99% of cohort pairs have no edge to begin with (44396 of 44850), so "joins films sharing no edge" is nearly free. The unreachable count is the number that discriminates, against a 70.59% chance baseline.

independentVerification.note: every headline number below was re-derived from static/corpus.json, harvest.json, enrich.json and fingerprints.json by a second implementation that shares no code with build-predicates-propC.js, resolving films by title+year against corpus.films rather than by plots.json slug, and using a different RNG (mulberry32, seed 20260810) for the permutation.

permutation.reading: the observed 66.71% falls outside the whole null distribution on the low side. The vocabulary joins films that are MORE reachable than random film sets of the same sizes, not less. This is the brief's own question answered against the layer.

permutationControl.note: film-set sizes held fixed, membership resampled uniformly from the 300-film cohort

structurallyUnreachableShare.note: the same test with the tonal clause dropped — no edge, no shared crew/cast/keyword, no common neighbour. This is the industrial question on its own.

meanTonalDistanceWithinPredicates.verdict: tonally TIGHTER than chance — the layer is partly re-deriving the fingerprint

perPredicateSignificance.note: the aggregate permutation can hide a good minority inside a bad average. This asks the question once per predicate: resample a film set of exactly this predicate's size uniformly from the 300-film cohort, 2,000 times, and ask how often chance joins at least as many unreachable pairs.
perPredicateSignificance.reading: not one of the 89 clears even the uncorrected 0.05 threshold, and 89 tests should have thrown ~4.5 false positives by chance alone. Getting zero is itself evidence of a systematic pull TOWARD reachability rather than a null result. No subset of this vocabulary can be defended as a stranger-joiner on this cohort.

mapImpact.note: a precondition, not a result. A cohort film with no predicate partner cannot have its top six changed by this layer at any strength. Nothing is merged and no edge is scored.

pairLoad.note: what the layer would ask the graph to carry. Not an edge count — a candidate-pair count, before any strength or budget is applied.

projectedAtCorpusScale.note: a predicate at the top of the proposal band holds 8% of the corpus. Pairs go as n squared, so the band bounds the vocabulary semantically and does not bound the graph at all. Arithmetic, not a measurement.

ordering.note: kept predicates are ordered by unreachable pairs joined, tonal mean as tiebreak

cuts.label: Another comes to stand in the place one party held — in a household, a role, an attachment — and the displaced one is passed over with no account they can live with.
cuts.reason: held by 8.67% of the cohort — a genre, not a predicament (proposal band 0.4-8%)

cuts.reason: held by 9% of the cohort — a genre, not a predicament (proposal band 0.4-8%)

strangerExamples.note: the pairs the layer would add that the current atlas has no route to at all — no edge, no shared crew, cast or keyword, no common neighbour, and outside each other's 200 nearest by five-axis distance. Ranked within each predicate by tonal distance, which is exactly the axis the fingerprint would use to bury them. These are illustrations of what the layer proposes, not a claim that the layer proposes them at a rate above chance — it does not.
